svg.title: Lab 09 — Physical equivalent of a GCP two-tier VPC
svg.desc: Packet Tracer reproduces the web/app tiers with VLANs, ACLs, NAT, DNS and an ISP edge — the same ideas Terraform declares in the cloud
svg.text: Lab 09 — Physical equivalent of a GCP two-tier VPC
Packet Tracer reproduces the web/app tiers with VLANs, ACLs, NAT, DNS and an ISP edge — the same ideas Terraform declares in the cloud
Design goal: only the web tier is exposed
The app tier and DNS live on a private VLAN; outbound access uses NAT, never inbound reachability
Everything the cloud gives you as a service (subnet, firewall rule, NAT, DNS) is a device or configuration you can see here.
Terraform labs 02–05 build exactly this two-tier layout with google_compute_* resources.
